claim_boundary: This protocol compares clean-room ExpeL-style, AWM-style, and ReasoningBank-style memory mechanisms. It is not an exact reproduction of the upstream repositories and is not weight, policy, or action-skill transfer.

upgrade_to_exact_baseline_requires: upstream induction and retrieval path actually executed
compatibility adapter tests against upstream outputs

estimands.primary: intent-to-treat paired delta in official target success versus target-only
estimands.abstention_policy: An empty artifact remains in the denominator and executes as a byte-equivalent target-only no-op.
secondary: conditional utility among episodes with at least one retrieved item (descriptive only)
estimands.forbidden: Selecting tasks, methods, memories, or seeds using qualification/formal outcomes

paired_target_execution.input_token_overhead: not artificially equalized; report it as an intrinsic method cost

requirements: one immutable task-ID list per target domain
initial-state or media hashes recorded before outcomes
all prior pilot and qualification tasks excluded
identical ordered tasks and seeds across all four arms
